codexThreadComment.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject unsupported units after a labeled value**

When a labeled supported unit is preceded by another field, this call consumes and later blanks the following number before the unsupported-unit scan reaches its suffix. Consequently, `parseMeasurement('age=28, kg=400 g')` returns 400 kg and `parseMeasurement('age=28, lbs=8 oz')` returns 8 lb, whereas the documented unsupported-weight behavior requires adjacent gram/ounce/stone parts to invalidate the weight. Preserve enough of the original labeled match for the unsupported-unit check, or reject the suffix before consuming the value.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L37-L39](https://github.com/afahy/fluent-measures/blob/b92e3aa9cd2323048b77c0d87151a94cee67bfd1/AGENTS.md#L37-L39)
